protocol.purpose: Paired native-terrain dry controls isolating nonlinear momentum transport in the same centered-enthalpy solver body
protocol.initial_wind: 4m/s analytic horizontal vortex sampled identically on every open native pressure port, then one shared explicit column-mass projection per region
protocol.initial_projection: Signed kinetic change separately reported; no added heat. Both backends receive the same prepared state.
protocol.retention: All six cases including failures and partial states retained; no best-outcome selection or modifications after outcomes
protocol.scope: Closed dry staircase terrain with synthetic initial climate, no vapor/rain/open boundaries/surface radiation or calibration

initial_projection.scope: Closed-domain minimum-kinetic initial projection, not a momentum time step or hidden heat correction.

thermal_transport.scope: Affine-centered native enthalpy equation; explicit reference flux divergence, no energy-residual feedback, clipping or renormalization.
